# Municipal Ordinance No. KauBayansaLaangGgulinBlg01, Series of 2002

**Supplemental Appropriation Ordinance for CY 2002 (Kautusang Bayan Para sa Karagdagang Laang-Ggulin Blg. 01, Serye ng Taong 2002)**

## Summary

This ordinance is a Supplemental Appropriation Ordinance for CY 2002, enacted to authorize additional appropriations and expenditures for the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], Quezon. It provides an additional budget allocation based on the increase in the municipality's income and available funds as of December 31, 2001. The ordinance authorizes the use of the supplemental budget for newly created positions, accrued leave/terminal pay, and general revision of tax declarations.

## Key Provisions

**Section 1 — Additional Income.** As of December 31, 2001, the total income of the Municipality of Pitogo amounted to approximately P 4,321,196.25, representing an increase over the prior period's income.

**Section 2 — Authorization.** The Supplemental Appropriation Ordinance (Karagdagang Laang-Ggulin Blg. 01 ng Taong 2002) is endorsed by the Punong Bayan and approved by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] as an additional appropriation component of this ordinance, in accordance with Annexes A and B.

**Section 3 — Uses of the Appropriation.** The supplemental budget covers the following:
- Newly created positions (newly created position)
- Accrued leave/terminal pay
- General Revision of Tax Declarations

**Section 4 — Effectivity.** The Supplemental Appropriation Ordinance (Kautusang Bayan sa Karagdagang Laang-Ggulin Blg. 01, Serye ng Taong 2002) shall take effect upon its approval.

**Section 5 — Approval Date.** Approved on the 15th of April 2002 at Pitogo, Quezon.

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]] — enacted the ordinance
- [[Domingo L. Tan]] — Municipal Mayor (Punong Bayan)
- [[Rodante V. Cortes]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer (Pangalawang Punong Bayan)
- [[Cesar B. Bunag]] — Municipal Assessor and Concurrent Sec. to the Sangguniang Bayan
